substantive: M-1: a mid-stream decode/parse error on a truncated/corrupt file surfaced a path-less OtError::Parse / UnsupportedLinkType; MultiPacketIter passed it through unwrapped, so EC-004's 'fail-fast naming file N' was unmet for the truncated case (the killed-tcpdump-G rotation the story exists to serve); also untested

m-2: story AC-003 exit-code wording self-contradictory (claimed 'same as BadInput' = 65, but BadInput maps to 2)
m-3: guard masks a missing intermediate file when a later file also mismatches link type (both genuine error states)
observations: iter_packets_multi(&[]) returns Ok yielding zero packets (no live caller)
MultiPacketIter did not latch terminal after an error (no live Vec<Result> collector)

passes.resolution: M-1 fixed: added OtError::StreamInFile { path, inner } wrapping mid-stream errors with the source file, exit code delegated; MultiPacketIter now tracks current_path, wraps, and latches terminal (also closes the latching observation). m-1 fixed (basename_of -> '<unknown>'). m-2 corrected in the story spec (65/EX_DATAERR consistent with UnsupportedLinkType). m-3 + multi-interface pcapng documented as accepted limitations (story Known-limitations + TD-S901-001). Empty-slice observation: no live caller, left as latent. Commit f54cf66; regression test mid_stream_error_names_the_offending_file. Orchestrator independently verified M-1 against code (path-less Parse at pcap.rs:235/240/258, exit-70; UnsupportedLinkType exit-65) and confirmed no existing test pinned the single-file shape before changing it.
passes.verification_discipline_note: Every finding verified against code before acceptance: M-1 confirmed real (path-less streaming errors); m-2 confirmed a spec-wording defect, not an impl defect (impl's 65 is correct); m-3 + multi-interface judged accepted-by-design and documented rather than coded.
